correctness.rationale: For \(k=5\), direct differentiation of the published \(K_1\) formula gives \(K'=S^4P/(p+L)^6\). Exact factorization yields \(P=(v-1)(v+1)v^5R(v+v^{-1};t)\). With \(z=v+v^{-1}-2\), the exact expansion of \(R(2+z;t)\) has a nonpositive constant coefficient and strictly negative coefficients of \(z,z^2,\ldots,z^5\) throughout \(0\le t\le(\sqrt{11}-2)/2\). Thus \(K\) is strictly decreasing for \(v>1\) on the physical domain; reciprocal symmetry supplies the left half. The reversible source reconstruction then gives the unique positive solution \((u,v)=((4\theta-2)/5,1)\).
